registration_timing: before any provider capability probe or architecture-neighborhood outcome
status_label: bounded Recursive Language Model control-flow neighborhood pilot

runtime.provider_seed: not available in the registered official adapter

restricted_repl.network_access: only official LM calls through the host handler
restricted_repl.failure_rule: retain attempted code and error in the trajectory; never relax restrictions after an outcome

registered_endpoints.primary: per-task answer-token match, reported by architecture without pooling task families
registered_endpoints.summary: accuracy/calls/tokens/time Pareto frontier; no scalarized winner
registered_endpoints.cell_failure: retained as an error outcome and scored incorrect
registered_endpoints.token_cap_semantics: official RLM soft cap checked between iterations and therefore permitted to overshoot within the final iteration

claim_boundary: This four-task, one-run-per-cell API pilot evaluates a local control-flow neighborhood around the official RLM implementation. It can expose task-specific accuracy, cost, latency, recursion-use, and failure differences among direct full-context, deterministic map/reduce, and RLM depths 1 and 2. It cannot estimate stochastic uncertainty, attribute effects to recursion independently of prompts and provider behavior, establish long-context scaling, compare trained model architectures, or support a general RLM-superiority claim.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
